intervals.label: collaboration: commissioning, then data taking
intervals.locator: Fermilab PAC public report, April 2026 meeting, "Status of the SpinQuest experiment and its dark sector upgrades"; APS April 2019 abstract: "Since the beginning of the SpinQuest commissioning in Fall 2018"; K. Liu talk Aug 2024: "E1039/SpinQuest: 2018 - now"
intervals.note: Start: commissioning began Fall 2018 (APS 2019 abstract). End: the PAC report says the experiment received about 10^15 protons on target in summer 2024 and no beam since; the end is placed at 2024-07, the month the Main Injector stopped operating (see accelerator:fermilab-main-injector). No fetched source dates the start of polarised-target physics data taking.
intervals.quote: The experiment received ~10^15 POT in the summer of 2024 but has not received a beam since then.

intervals.label: collaboration: no beam (switchyard SY120 not operating)
intervals.locator: Fermilab PAC public report, April 2026 meeting, summary section
intervals.note: The experiment has had no beam since summer 2024. The April 2026 PAC report says SY120, which feeds SpinQuest, will not be operated before the long shutdown (planned 2028-29) because of budget constraints; the experiment had planned to take data in Q4 2026 if the switchyard run were not cancelled and has a four-year plan for after the long shutdown. A temporary stop, not an end of the experiment.
intervals.quote: SY120, which will not be operated before the LS due to budget constraints

website.quote: The SpinQuest experiment is designed to explore a very particular aspect of proton and neutron structure: Are the sea quarks orbiting around the spin axis of the nucleon?

summary.plain: The collaboration of about 22 institutions from 7 countries running the SpinQuest polarised Drell-Yan experiment at Fermilab.
